correctness.rationale: Exact weighted monomial Gram integration proves all shift weights; strictly log-convex moment ratios force a single minimum on each of n two-sided residue chains; summing each squared-weight total variation proves the trace class norm, trace zero and weight monotonicity. Each polar-defect tail has coefficient n(alpha+1)/2 per lattice direction, yielding sorted singular coefficient n(alpha+1) and sharp Schatten threshold. Rational arithmetic script successfully checked 7665 Gram coefficients, 840 valleys, 60 unweighted norms and 32 asymptotic tail probes. Finite tests are only supplementary.
